source_note: Consolidates already executed/source-traced audits. Relevant native implementation was unchanged at documentation checkpoint8a5196aa97a73cdae1393e27529bd51914fc1b0f. This consolidation runs no game tests and makes no production/remote changes.

development_apk_publication_policy.existing_policy: Build/launch/run failures and required updater/multiplayer failures block publication. Visual/style/balance findings remain diagnostics. A publishable development APK is distinct from a conservatively completed game.
development_apk_publication_policy.matrix_effect: No new blocking CI, workflow, publisher or publication cadence is created. Functional findings are evaluated under existing user policy, not by changing it. Per-title completion stages are acceptance criteria for a completed-game/stable-utility claim.
development_apk_publication_policy.publication_verdict: not_assigned; root audit owns exact APK/build/artifact evaluation

evidence_interpretation.actual_module_reproduction: Actual production module callbacks or interaction functions executed; exact probe/log identifies whether real graphics were included.
evidence_interpretation.source_traced: Code path/data flow established without executing the specified Android/device interaction. Do not promote to runtime acceptance.
evidence_interpretation.rendered_capture: Actual GLES framebuffer or authentic Android artifact inspected; projection-specific findings are not universal headset judgments.
evidence_interpretation.synthetic_world_integration: Actual production simulation/module runs on bounded fixture world; does not establish packaged geographic world admission.
evidence_interpretation.physical_acceptance: Not established by these workstream audits; retained device requirements support completion claims, not newly invented publication CI.
evidence_interpretation.negative_result: A suspected bug was not reproduced in the stated cases; this does not prove absence for every state/device sequence.
evidence_interpretation.test_exit_interpretation: Classics save probes and recent Guess/Breakwater probes intentionally fail release expectations and report nonzero exits. Featured probes assert and record defect reproductions, so their zero exits are not product-fix claims.

shared_host_findings.title: Quick Menu continues native Update
shared_host_findings.observed: While Quick Menu is visible, renderer calls native update with POINTER_NONE; runtime still computes delta and reads retained joystick axes/buttons. JNI invokes module update without paused guard. POINTER_NONE suppresses sound afterward, not time or held controls.
shared_host_findings.affected_scope: All registered native paths; actual simulation effect depends on module. Pong/Snake/Breakout movement and board CPU work are explicitly traced.
shared_host_findings.completion_impact: Safe pause semantics are not established; an active arcade run may advance while settings are read.
repair_exit_criteria: Opening intended pause menu produces no simulation or CPU-result advancement over a controlled interval.
Returning resumes with correct clock policy and deliberate input; per-eye rendering does not advance state.

shared_host_findings.title: Home tears down and RESUME NATIVE constructs a new instance
shared_host_findings.observed: Quick Menu Home releases GL then requests stop; Activity stops runtime; runtime invokes native Pause/Destroy; JNI closes module. RESUME NATIVE starts ordinary playback, which creates a new instance. Label availability checks module identity, not a saved match.
shared_host_findings.affected_scope: All admitted native modules; exact loss/restoration depends on each save implementation. All eight classic loss cases were already reproduced at this exact lifecycle boundary.
shared_host_findings.completion_impact: Resume label cannot imply durable continuation where module state is not persisted. Android Back outside Quick Menu also takes stop/Home route.
repair_exit_criteria: Home→RESUME restores the declared per-title continuation state, or truthfully offers a fresh session without mislabeling it.
Each title preserves costly/once-only state across Pause/Destroy/Create and rejects destructive recovery without deliberate action.

shared_host_findings.title: Release events while Quick Menu is open can leave joystick state latched
shared_host_findings.observed: Native button/axis values persist in VirtualInputBus. Ordinary Menu resets HID keyboard/mouse only. Suppressed binding callbacks discard releases/zero axes while physical router still advances previous-edge state. Closing Menu only changes flags. Update continues reading retained values.
shared_host_findings.affected_scope: Native Daydream SELECT/touchpad bindings on ordinary or recovery menu path; Home teardown separately releases hosted profile.
shared_host_findings.completion_impact: Held Select or pad direction can remain active after its physical release was suppressed; this is not yet an executed device reproduction.
repair_exit_criteria: Hold Select or nonzero pad, open menu, release inside menu, close without new input: guest buttons/axes remain zero during menu and on return.
Repeat via headset-recovery menu entry and all supported controller sources; re-arm only from a clean neutral state.

items: Activity Pause releases bindings, resets HID, calls native Pause and pauses CardboardView; resume resets elapsed-clock baseline.
Controller disconnect/source changes release input and use a neutral-control resume gate.
Home ends hosted profile, releasing its input; its loss risk is persistence, distinct from Close-menu latch risk.
